S — Synthetic presenting problem; resolved into stage 2 hypertension when a week of home readings confirmed it. Not a claim about her real health.

Bilateral primary knee osteoarthritis, worse on the left: pain on stairs and on rising from a chair, morning stiffness under 30 minutes, crepitus and bony enlargement without warmth; clinical diagnosis without imaging: active, confirmed [S]
Fall risk: one fall in the past year, a trip on the outside steps without injury; afraid of falling and going out less; STEADI screen positive; Timed Up and Go 15 seconds: active, confirmed [S]
Obesity, class 1 (BMI 31.6); she calls herself stout and wants to lose some weight for her knees: active, confirmed [S]

Dignified, culturally safe care: address her as Mrs. Seacole; respect her expertise as a nurse and healer; ask about her remedies openly and check them for interactions without dismissing them; explain each choice plainly and let her decide; solve access barriers (a free home blood pressure cuff in a large size, transport, the stairs) rather than treat them as non-adherence. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); Licorice Root (2026) [S]

Geriatric medicine consultation within one week for a comprehensive geriatric assessment: falls, blood pressure targets and medicine choices in an older woman living alone, knee osteoarthritis, mood and social needs. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); STEADI: Stopping Elderly Accidents, Deaths, and Injuries (2026) [S]

Confirm the blood pressure: home readings twice daily for seven days with a validated upper-arm monitor and a large cuff, technique taught; ECG, metabolic panel, lipids, hemoglobin A1c, TSH, urine albumin and blood count today; an echocardiogram for stage 2 readings with ECG voltage for left ventricular hypertrophy; treatment decided at the one-week review. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension, osteoarthritis and osteoporosis monographs (2026) [S]

Knee osteoarthritis: exercise therapy with a physical therapist, then a tai chi class at the community center; diclofenac 1% gel; a 5% weight loss; a cane, fitted and used in the right hand; no oral anti-inflammatory medicines because of her blood pressure and kidneys; a corticosteroid injection as an option for a flare. Guideline: 2019 American College of Rheumatology/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee (2019); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension, osteoarthritis and osteoporosis monographs (2026) [S]

Falls (STEADI): screen, then Timed Up and Go, 30-second chair stand, 4-stage balance test and orthostatic blood pressure at visits; medicine review against the Beers criteria; vision and footwear checks; a home safety visit by an occupational therapist, with a rail for the stairs to her rooms; exercise for strength and balance. Guideline: STEADI: Stopping Elderly Accidents, Deaths, and Injuries (2026); Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions (2024); American Geriatrics Society 2023 Updated AGS Beers Criteria for Potentially Inappropriate Medication Use in Older Adults (2023) [S]

Her own remedies, checked with her: liquorice root can raise blood pressure and lower potassium, so she will pause it while her blood pressure is treated (her decision); ginger tea in food amounts is fine; her camphor and wintergreen liniment contains a salicylate, so it is used on a different knee or at a different time from the diclofenac gel, never under a heat pad, and kept away from the eyes. Guideline: 2019 American College of Rheumatology/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee (2019); Licorice Root (2026); Ginger (2026) [S]

Loneliness and costs: a social prescribing link worker; the tai chi group and a lunch club near her home; a check of the help she is entitled to with costs and transport; generic medicines and a 90-day supply. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025) [S]

Lifestyle: less salted fish and pickled food, more vegetables and fruit, regular walking, and alcohol kept to occasions. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, hypertension, osteoarthritis and osteoporosis monographs (2026) [S]
